title: 2022 Year-End Review | COPICafe Episode 36 | Cornucopias
description:
Accomplishments of 2022, a BIG year ahead of us and some great leaks.



In the first COPICafe of 2023, Rob & Josh review everything the team has accomplished in the past year. Josh announces a meme contest for the community for a FREE NFT. They guys agree on their favorite highlight of the year. They briefly touch on coming in 2023 (more on that next episode). After wrapping up a meeting with David (our creative director) they guys can't help themselves from describing the infrastructure under Solace. And as always they end the episode with a little show and tell. Enjoy the episode and get ready for a big year ahead of us!


00:00 - Beverage Choices
04:06 - Q1 2022 Recap
07:39 - Meme Contest NFT Giveaway
08:08 - Q2 2022 Recap
15:08 -  Q3 2022 Recap
20:48 - Q4 2022 Recap
28:13 - Highlight of the Year
31:50 - Big Year Ahead!
33:03 - LEAKS!


Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw


#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK
